environment.physicalDevice: Sony NW-ZX706 in USB DAC mode, HAL name WALKMAN

measurementBoundary: Known original local fixture through Spotify, process tap and filo exclusive relay to raw bytes supplied by the actual WALKMAN software output IOProc; USB receiver and analog output unmeasured.

reference.independentExpectedBytesMethod: Read canonical packed24 RIFF samples with Python wave; decode signed little-endian integers; shift each left by8 and pack as signed little-endian32; hash all bytes.

interpretationLimits: Six successful runs prove complete finite waveform and raw signed32 output bytes at the stated software boundary.
Seven failures have no reference alignment and no compared reference bytes; zero mismatch fields are not successful comparisons.
All seven failure output-capture hashes independently match same-length all-zero data; the rejected input callback was not retained.
Failure occurs with both mutedWhenTapped and unmuted and with following enabled and disabled; neither mute suppression nor clock following is necessary for the observed failure.
The first8 runs showed new-file failures and replay passes, but held-route runs10,11 and12 passed new-file selections, and earlier source-only first selections passed.
Holding the route did not guarantee success: its first ALAC trial, run9, failed without warmup playback, followed by passing FLAC,ALAC and WAV selections.

After Spotify was quit and relaunched under the same held route, first ALAC playback in run13 failed; this is additional startup-state evidence, not identification of an internal renderer or decoder cause.
No source gain curve, decoder reset, resampler activation, renderer transition, USB receiver data, or subscription master was measured.

Run9 includes231424 pre-prime startup-silence frames excluded from its512-frame raw output capture; run13 includes736256 pre-prime startup-silence frames excluded from its3072-frame capture; neither early-failure capture is the entire IOProc timeline.
